_doc: Palette v4 colour map for code (2D Artist, 2026-09-30; Bar: 'more Israel theme and palette'). Supersedes palette-v3-map.json (v3 was never applied to the scripts): every pair maps the v2 colour the scripts hard-code TODAY straight to v4. The flag's layout on the main screen: the HUD band is flag blue, the card pane between the blue ticker and the blue tab bar is a WHITE field, the cards on it are flag blue with white text, navy stays only behind the stage and in wells. Text colours that sat on navy are lifted so they clear 4.5:1 on the flag blues. Apply with tools/apply_palette_map.py (dry run by default, --write, --check). 'perFile' overrides a pair for one file where one hex plays two roles.

_engineNotes: The white card pane (main.gd _fills.shop) is a field for CARDS: never draw text straight on it (white labels would vanish; if the mobile layout needs a pane label, give it a ui_panel plate or draw it in ui_bubble-on-white #1045b5, 7.5:1).
